text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A few days after meeting Daring Heart...
Before I knew it, my eyes were constantly tracking her movements.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
Heart is eating lunch alone again!
...Whoa! Aren't you eating way more than before...!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Haha, I'm bulking up right now.
It's all to get this body into peak condition for the mock race.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend D
text_block_list.text:
A mock race... with Rhein Kraft and the others!
I heard they're super strong~. But you've got this in the bag, Heart♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No. Craft, Cesario, Messiah...
They all possess incredible potential. They won't be easy opponents by any means.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Line Craft, Cesario, Air Messiah—
Formidable horsegirls all aiming for the same Tiara route as Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Daring Heart is talented too.
Yet, if there's one area where she falls slightly short of them—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Where I'm lacking is... physique.
To prevail in a fierce shoulder-to-shoulder battle, physical conditioning is crucial.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So for now, I'll be continuing my solo lunches.
Once things settle down, let's eat together again♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her plate was piled high with food, far too much for her slender frame.
She seemed determined to pack it away through sheer force of will.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I can do this...—I still have room...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... Clean plate.
—...Oh? Hey!
choice_data_list: ...Ah, h-hey there! Long time no see!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I was hoping to see you again!
Would you like to hang out for a bit? There's actually a favor I'd like to ask of you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Please let me know if you notice anything off"—
With those words, I ended up watching over her training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The weights she held were far heavier than I imagined.
She was subjecting herself to a load unthinkable for her build.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: —...Ngh...! Not yet—...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her form was beginning to slip slightly; at this rate, it wouldn't be effective.
In fact, she was risking injury. Unable to watch any longer, I spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: No, not yet... I can keep going...! Just two more sets...!
choice_data_list: You're holding your breath... You're close to your limit.
You're holding your breath... You're close to your limit.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Ah...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (...You're right... I didn't even notice—...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Alright. I guess I was getting ahead of myself... Thanks for pointing it out.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You have a sharp, objective eye for reading situations—
Heh, so you really are a capable Trainer. ...By the way, who are you in charge of?
choice_data_list: I haven't taken on any trainees yet.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Really? Huh... That's unexpected.
So your journey is just beginning too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's right... Your career as a Trainer, and my path to becoming Queen—
it's all ahead of us. Ah... Isn't that thrilling!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes. What I'm aiming for is the Triple Tiara.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
When I watched Japan's Triple Tiara races...
I made a solemn vow in my heart. That I, too, would wear that floral crown!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Tiara—a title bestowed upon the horsegirl who conquers
all three Classic-class races: the Oka Sho, the Yushun Himba (Oaks), and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Soon, I'll be running in a mock race against classmates aiming for the Tiara route.
It'll be the opening stage where all my destined rivals gather. —That is precisely why.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll train for even one second longer, and gain even one more gram of muscle.
My meals, my daily life—I will dedicate everything to victory!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And I will become the Queen of the Triple Tiara—without fail!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What she spoke of wasn't merely a dream... but a future destined to arrive.
—Her intense drive stirred something deep within me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's a good place to wrap things up.
You're such a great listener... I got completely carried away!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out for a run outside now.
Sorry to trouble you, but could you hand me my bag?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I reached to hand her the bag,
her open planner caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't a single blank space in her schedule.
She had whittled away every spare second—pushing herself to the absolute brink.
choice_data_list: (She's even spending her sleeping hours reading literature...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...? Is something wrong?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh... about my schedule? Hehe, you really are a worrywart, aren't you?
Don't worry, I'm plenty tough♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—It's all to win. If you want to stand ahead of everyone else, you have to outwork everyone else.
Without rest, without breaking—even if I have to crawl, I'll keep moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Disadvantages, reckless odds—I'll overpower every single one of them.
I'll polish my "Daring Heart" to perfection and seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
To become the absolute best version of myself,
I can't afford to stand still. ...Not even for a single second.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll make a wonderful Trainer.
You're just so kind, after all. A little... too kind for me, even.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An unyielding, razor-sharp conviction
drives her relentlessly forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She is strong. Her spirit, her gaze, her resolve.
Perhaps a horsegirl this strong... doesn't even need my help.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She leaves herself no breathing room at all.
If she keeps going like this... will her body and mind really be okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What if, someday... that taut, strained thread
suddenly snaps...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that were to happen,
and cloud that noble "Daring Heart" of hers—
choice_data_list: I couldn't bear to let that happen...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To prevent that, I have to meet her heart head-on.
—Armed with a weapon of my very own.
